phase: Complete painted settlement program before slicing or native selection
anchor_basis: Visible architectural identity callouts in the whole master. These are review anchors, not final alpha masks, click geometry or foundation certification.

sites.name: Council Clock Hall
sites.identity: Broad upper-left civic hall, clock tower, formal Piltover banners and level masonry forecourt

sites.name: Hextech Academy and Observatory
sites.identity: Dominant central-right institution with large blue observatory dome, academic wings and formal public entry

sites.name: Warden Citadel and Gate
sites.identity: Far-right twin civic watchtowers, portcullis and connected city-wall landing

sites.name: Public Inn
sites.identity: Middle-left timber/slate social house with warm doorway and sheltered frontage

sites.name: Civic Market
sites.identity: Foreground central merchant hall with joined canopy stalls and open trade frontage

sites.name: Hextech Foundry
sites.identity: Large foreground-left open orange forge, blue induction cylinders, brass frame and full inset left silhouette

sites.name: Blue Power Substation
sites.identity: Distinct compact middle-right brass utility house enclosing tall blue crystal power apparatus

sites.name: Museum of Progress
sites.identity: Separate dignified central portico/gallery between assembly quarter and Academy

sites.name: Cargo Exchange
sites.identity: Large foreground-right dry mercantile warehouse and goods entrance; optional boat/dock remains a separate site

sites.name: Cadet Academy and Station
sites.identity: Small separate two-storey civic station behind the foundry, navy public-service banner and exposed public entrance

sites.name: Rifle Corps Lodge
sites.identity: Long-roof far-left guard/rifle lodge with distinct sheltered training frontage

sites.name: Freight Automaton Depot
sites.identity: Separate middle-right broad goods/workshop frontage above the Cargo Exchange, dry ramps and depot bays

sites.name: Hexbow Artificers' Atelier
sites.identity: Gabled middle-left artisan house with brass-blue detailing and its own visible door beside the cadet block

sites.name: Stomper Shield Laboratory
sites.identity: Separate central-near workshop with braced roof, blue monitoring aperture and protected shield-engineering interior

sites.name: Rotorwing Flight-Testing Loft
sites.identity: High middle-left grounded testing veranda, folded rotor rigs and modest aviation calibration mast

sites.name: Rampager and Dreadnought Assembly Hangar
sites.identity: Large middle-left arched machine assembly bay with low four-legged chassis and protected blue apparatus

sites.name: Shipyard, Quay and Moored Sloop
sites.identity: Intentional supported waterfront site only: distinct dock/gangway and complete compact boat inside the right canvas edge

sites.name: Progress Orrery
sites.identity: Separate central blue crystal/brass civic orrery, on its own level landing clear of the Museum and Academy doors
